note: Curated half of the parameter catalog (docs/parameters.md, Parameter catalog). Edit the words and ranges here; objects' modes, sizes and per-size defaults come from the engine. Rebuild spec/parameters.json with PARAMS_CATALOG_WRITE=1 cargo test -p core_engine --test parameter_catalog -- --ignored.

patterns.label: Working
patterns.description: Busy on a task: particles circle on tilted orbits while the agent works.

patterns.label: Searching
patterns.description: Looking something up: a scan line sweeps across a globe of dots.

patterns.label: Solving
patterns.description: Reasoning through a problem: bands twist like a puzzle cube, then settle.

patterns.label: Listening
patterns.description: The agent is listening: a wave rolls through rings while the user talks.

patterns.label: Connecting
patterns.description: Joining a session or linking ideas: a constellation wires itself together.

patterns.label: Weaving
patterns.description: Combining sources: three strands braid around the sphere.

patterns.label: Composing
patterns.description: Writing a reply: a ribbon of dots flows around the sphere.

patterns.label: Breathing
patterns.description: Idle and ready: a calm ring that slowly breathes.

patterns.label: Shaping
patterns.description: Reshaping or formatting: an outline morphs from circle to triangle to square.

patterns.label: Glowing
patterns.description: An ambient presence: a colored nebula drifting on a sphere.

patterns.label: Drifting
patterns.description: A looser constellation: its nodes wander on a smooth noise field.

patterns.label: Speaking
patterns.description: The agent is speaking: circular EQ bars pulse while it talks.

patterns.label: Confirming
patterns.description: Done or received: a ping ring expands and fades.

patterns.label: Initializing
patterns.description: Starting a session: a starfield streams outward from the center.

patterns.label: Calibrating
patterns.description: Tuning in: a standing-wave pattern snaps into new resonances.

patterns.label: Progressing
patterns.description: Progress on a sphere: a day and night line sweeps left to right as the app sets progress (0 to 1).

patterns.label: Concluding
patterns.description: Wrapping up: loose dots snap into a crystal, hold, then let go.

patterns.label: Muted
patterns.description: Mic muted or connection lost: a still, dimmed sphere.

patterns.label: Silhouette
patterns.description: A head and shoulders of evenly spread dots that lives with the voice: waves come in while it listens, flicker at the eyes while it thinks and spread from the mouth while it speaks.

patterns.label: Bars
patterns.description: Live audio as a row of rounded bars, like an equalizer.

patterns.label: Waveform
patterns.description: Live audio as a continuous oscilloscope wave.

patterns.label: Scrolling
patterns.description: A recording's history: level pills scroll left, like a voice message.

patterns.label: Meter
patterns.description: Levels on an LED dot grid, like a vintage spectrum analyzer.

patterns.label: Playing
patterns.description: A recorded voice message: its waveform, with the played part in full ink and the rest dimmed.

patterns.label: Completing
patterns.description: Determinate progress: an arc fills clockwise from 0 to 1.

patterns.label: Loading
patterns.description: Indeterminate loading: an arc that grows, shrinks and keeps spinning.

patterns.label: Tracking
patterns.description: Several values at once as concentric rings, such as daily goals.

patterns.label: Stepping
patterns.description: Steps filling in order, like 3 of 5 done.

patterns.label: Measuring
patterns.description: A value on an open dial, like a gauge or a volume meter.

patterns.label: Talking
patterns.description: Who is speaking: a ring around an avatar that thickens with the voice and never covers the face.

patterns.label: Generating
patterns.description: Content loading inline: a skeleton shimmer glides across a pill.

patterns.label: Typing
patterns.description: Someone is typing: three dots bounce in sequence.

patterns.label: Notifying
patterns.description: Something new arrived: a badge with ripples that expand and fade.

patterns.label: Reconnecting
patterns.description: Connection quality or reconnecting: a pulsing dot in a four-part ring.

patterns.label: Locating
patterns.description: A location and its accuracy: a dot in a halo that pulses outward.

patterns.label: Scanning
patterns.description: Scanning nearby: a radar beam sweeps over a dot-field scope.

patterns.label: Broadcasting
patterns.description: Live or on air: a dot with radio arcs that light in sequence.

patterns.label: Buzzy
patterns.description: A small space-hero assistant with a face screen: shape eyes, a gaze that knows whose turn it is, and a voice line for a mouth.

patterns.label: Hum
patterns.description: A vintage studio microphone that hosts the show: its grille lights with the voice, and a tally light shows when it's listening.

patterns.label: Wisp
patterns.description: A helpful spirit with a curling smoke tail: its sparkles gather in while it listens, orbit while it thinks and stream out with its voice.

patterns.label: Chirp
patterns.description: A small songbird: its beak opens with the voice and notes float out, it tilts its head to listen, and its crest droops while it thinks.

patterns.label: Cuppa
patterns.description: A coffee mug on its saucer: its steam rises while it listens, curls while it thinks and thickens with its voice.

patterns.label: Bean
patterns.description: A coffee bean on little feet: aroma sparkles gather while it listens, orbit while it thinks and stream out with its voice.

patterns.label: Beep
patterns.description: A small tin robot with arms: a hand to the ear to listen, to the chin to think, small beats as it speaks; its antenna light shows when it listens and thinks.

trackOpacity@arc.description: Opacity of the faint track behind the indicator (0 = none).

trackOpacity@gauge.label: Track
trackOpacity@gauge.description: Opacity of the faint track behind the indicator (0 = none).

trackOpacity@nested.label: Track
trackOpacity@nested.description: Opacity of the faint track behind the indicator (0 = none).

trackOpacity@segmented.label: Track
trackOpacity@segmented.description: Opacity of the faint track behind the indicator (0 = none).

trackOpacity@shimmer.label: Track
trackOpacity@shimmer.description: Opacity of the track behind the highlight (0 = highlight only).

trackOpacity@spinner.label: Track
trackOpacity@spinner.description: Opacity of the faint track behind the indicator (0 = none).

trailFill@radar.label: Filled wedge
trailFill@radar.description: Draw the trail as one filled gradient wedge.

trailLength@radar.label: Trail
trailLength@radar.description: Length of the sweep's fading trail, in degrees.

turns@braid.label: Turns
turns@braid.description: How many times the strands twist around each other.

waveSweep@broadcast.label: Wave sweep
waveSweep@broadcast.description: Arc of each wave in degrees.

wobMul@ribbon.label: Wobble
wobMul@ribbon.description: How much the ribbon wobbles as it turns.

wobMul@ring.label: Wobble
wobMul@ring.description: How much the ribbon wobbles as it turns.

yaw@hush.label: Turn
yaw@hush.description: Slow turning speed of the sphere.

glint@silhouette.label: Glints
glint@silhouette.description: Dots that catch the light now and then (idle).

inward@silhouette.label: Listening waves
inward@silhouette.description: Waves travelling in from the outline, stronger with the mic level (listening).

neuron@silhouette.label: Thinking flicker
neuron@silhouette.description: Dots flickering along the eye line (thinking).

speech@silhouette.label: Speaking waves
speech@silhouette.description: Waves spreading from the mouth with the voice's level (speaking).

hologram@silhouette.label: Hologram
hologram@silhouette.description: A brighter rim and, now and then, a thin band sliding sideways.

scanlines@silhouette.label: Scanlines
scanlines@silhouette.description: Bands moving down over the dots.

rim@silhouette.label: Outline
rim@silhouette.description: Strength of the outline and its glow.

turnYaw@silhouette.label: Turn sideways
turnYaw@silhouette.description: Where the head faces, sideways (-1..1; negative = the viewer's left). The shoulders stay.

waveSpeed@silhouette.label: Wave speed
waveSpeed@silhouette.description: Waves per second for the listening, thinking and speaking motion.

dotSize@silhouette.label: Dot size
dotSize@silhouette.description: Dot size, relative to the default.

saturation@silhouette.label: Tint
saturation@silhouette.description: Colour strength of the dots and outline (0 = grey ink).

flow@speaker.label: Flow
flow@speaker.description: Ripples outside the ring: +1 travel outward (giving out, speaking), -1 come inward (taking in, listening), 0 none. The voice states set it.

hue@speaker.label: Hue
hue@speaker.description: Ink hue in degrees; applies once saturation is above 0.

idleOpacity@speaker.label: Resting opacity
idleOpacity@speaker.description: The ring's opacity when nobody is speaking (0 = hidden until there's a voice).

innerRadius@speaker.label: Avatar radius
innerRadius@speaker.description: Radius of the avatar the ring surrounds, as a fraction of the frame; nothing is drawn inside it.

reach@speaker.label: Reach
reach@speaker.description: How much thicker the ring grows at full voice, outward only, as a fraction of the frame.

rippleCount@speaker.label: Ripples
rippleCount@speaker.description: How many ripples travel at once when flow is on.

saturation@speaker.label: Saturation
saturation@speaker.description: How far the ink moves from grey toward the hue (0 = the grey ink).

shimmer@speaker.label: Shimmer
shimmer@speaker.description: A brighter arc that circles the ring (thinking, connecting); 0 = off.

thickness@speaker.label: Thickness
thickness@speaker.description: The ring's resting stroke width, as a fraction of the frame.

avatarGap@speaker.label: Avatar gap
avatarGap@speaker.description: Space between the avatar's edge and the ring, as a fraction of the frame.

envelope@playback.label: Envelope
envelope@playback.description: The recorded clip's loudness, oldest first, 0 to 1 per value (up to 64; resample longer clips). Without it a fixed sample message is drawn.

progress@playback.label: Progress
progress@playback.description: Playback position, 0 to 1: bars before it are played (full ink), the rest dimmed.

barCount@playback.label: Bars
barCount@playback.description: How many bars to draw: 0 = one per envelope value; otherwise the envelope is resampled (keeping peaks).

barWidth@playback.label: Bar width
barWidth@playback.description: Bar width as a fraction of each slot.

minHeight@playback.label: Min height
minHeight@playback.description: Height of a silent bar, as a fraction of full height.

unplayedOpacity@playback.label: Unplayed
unplayedOpacity@playback.description: Opacity of the bars not played yet, relative to the played ones.

playhead@playback.label: Playhead
playhead@playback.description: Draw a thin line at the playback position.

hue@playback.label: Hue
hue@playback.description: Ink hue in degrees; applies once saturation is above 0.

saturation@playback.label: Saturation
saturation@playback.description: How far the ink moves from grey toward the hue (0 = the grey ink).

hue@buzzy.label: Hue
hue@buzzy.description: Turns the shell's colour (and its line and screen tints) in degrees; the eyes and the amber accents stay.

hue@hum.label: Hue
hue@hum.description: Turns the capsule's colour in degrees; the brass, the grille, the eyes and the tally stay.

swayGain@hum.label: Sway
swayGain@hum.description: How far the capsule sways on its yoke with the voice while speaking (radians).

mouth@character.label: Mouth
mouth@character.description: Draw the mouth (Buzzy's voice line, Hum's lit grille, Wisp's opening oval, Chirp's beak); off keeps it at rest.

accessories@character.label: Accessories
accessories@character.description: The character's extras: Buzzy's crest, ear chevrons and listening arcs; Hum's tally light; Wisp's sparkles; Chirp's notes and thought dots.

grain@character.label: Grain
grain@character.description: Film grain inside the character's bodies (FX Spec 1.13, design note 22): a fine, still noise of light and dark specks. 0 = none; a recipe's `grain` sets its default. Left out at 20 px; an FX Spec resolved under low power turns it off.

shading@character.label: Soft shading
shading@character.description: Whether a recipe's soft layers draw: `shade` masses (airbrushed shadows, highlights, a blush) and `rim` light (FX Spec 1.13, design note 22). An FX Spec resolved under low power turns them off.

eyeStyle@character.label: Eye style
eyeStyle@character.description: How the eyes are drawn (FX Spec 1.13, design note 24): `auto` keeps the recipe's; `shape` is the solid shape eye; `glossy` adds an iris and pupil that follow the gaze, highlights that stay with the light and a lid line; `pixel` lights the eye as a grid of cells (and the mouth on a `faceScreen`); `dot` is a soft glowing point. Blinks, the gaze and expressions work in every style.

arms@character.label: Arms
arms@character.description: The character's arms (Beep): a hand to the ear while listening, to the chin while thinking, beats while speaking. Off: no arms.

look@character.label: Look around
look@character.description: How much the eyes glance around on their own while idle (0 = always at the viewer).

seed@character.label: Seed
seed@character.description: Changes when it blinks and glances, so two characters side by side don't move in sync.

eyeW@character.label: Eye width
eyeW@character.description: Eye width, in the character's 200-unit design box.

eyeR@character.label: Eye roundness
eyeR@character.description: Eye corner radius, in design units.

lid@character.label: Lid
lid@character.description: How far the top lid comes down (a squint), 0 to 0.9 of the eye.

eyeTilt@character.label: Lid slope
eyeTilt@character.description: Slope of the lid: positive lowers the outer corners (pensive).

eyeSmile@character.label: Eye smile
eyeSmile@character.description: The happy arc cut from below the eyes.

eyeAsym@character.label: Eye asymmetry
eyeAsym@character.description: Makes the left eye shorter (a quizzical look).

gazeX@character.label: Gaze X
gazeX@character.description: Where the eyes look, sideways, in design units (negative = left).

gazeY@character.label: Gaze Y
gazeY@character.description: Where the eyes look, up and down, in design units (negative = up).

lean@character.label: Lean
lean@character.description: Leans the whole character toward the viewer (design units).

tilt@character.label: Tilt
tilt@character.description: Tilts the whole character (radians; positive = clockwise).

squashGain@character.label: Squash
squashGain@character.description: How much the voice squashes the body while speaking.

bounceGain@character.label: Bounce
bounceGain@character.description: How far the voice lifts the body while speaking (design units).

mouthGain@character.label: Mouth gain
mouthGain@character.description: How far the voice line swings with the level.

mouthTalk@character.label: Talking mouth
mouthTalk@character.description: Above 0.5 the mouth is the voice line (speaking).

mouthDots@character.label: Thinking dots
mouthDots@character.description: Above 0.5 the mouth is three thinking dots.

earGain@character.label: Ear arcs
earGain@character.description: How strongly the listening sound arcs show with the user's level.

turnBlink@character.label: Turn blink
turnBlink@character.description: Blink once as this state starts (the end of the user's turn).

turn@character.label: 3D turn
turn@character.description: How far the head turns like a solid (0 = flat, 1 = ±35°; the default is ±25°).

turnYaw@character.label: Turn sideways
turnYaw@character.description: Where this state faces, sideways (-1..1 of the turn; negative = the viewer's left).

turnPitch@character.label: Turn up/down
turnPitch@character.description: Where this state faces, up or down (-1..1 of the turn; positive = up).

turnWander@character.label: Look corner to corner
turnWander@character.description: How much the head looks from corner to corner on its own, holding each look.

turnNod@character.label: Nod with the voice
turnNod@character.description: How much the head nods with the voice level.

hue@wisp.label: Hue
hue@wisp.description: Turns the spirit's colour (violet and teal together) in degrees; the sparkles and the eyes stay.

curlGain@wisp.label: Tail curl
curlGain@wisp.description: How tightly the smoke tail curls (thinking curls it most).

hue@chirp.label: Hue
hue@chirp.description: Turns the bird's coral body in degrees; the crest, wings, beak and eyes stay.

hue@cuppa.label: Hue
hue@cuppa.description: Turns the mug's colour in degrees; the coffee, the sleeve and the heart stay.

hue@bean.label: Hue
hue@bean.description: Turns the bean's roast in degrees; the cheeks and the aroma stay.

hue@beep.label: Hue
hue@beep.description: Turns the robot's steel in degrees; the screen, the orange accents and the antenna light stay.

flutterGain@chirp.label: Wing flutter
flutterGain@chirp.description: How much the wings flutter with the voice while speaking (radians).

materials.label: Glow
materials.description: Layered or blurred halos around every dot and stroke.

materials.label: Noise
materials.description: Organic jitter from a slow gradient-noise field.

materials.label: Pulse
materials.description: A periodic breathe of opacity and scale on any pattern.

materials.label: Gradient
materials.description: A colour ramp by position across the frame.

materials.label: Colour
materials.description: One brand colour for the whole frame.

materials.label: Liquid
materials.description: Metaball contours: dots and strokes melt into blobs.

materials.label: Particles
materials.description: A stateless particle layer emitted from the pattern.

materials.label: Holographic
materials.description: A foil hue sweep over each element's own lightness.

runtimeInputs.label: Audio level
runtimeInputs.description: The live voice level 0 to 1; drives the radial breathing pulse on any pattern.

runtimeInputs.label: Audio strength
runtimeInputs.description: How strongly, and in which direction, the audio level moves the frame: positive swells it outward as the level rises (speaking), negative draws it inward (listening's inhale), 0 turns it off.

runtimeInputs.label: Audio bands
runtimeInputs.description: Per-band levels (from the voice pipeline) for bar heights and waveform layers.

runtimeInputs.label: History
runtimeInputs.description: The scrolling waveform's caller-owned sample buffer.

runtimeInputs.label: Voice state
runtimeInputs.description: The synthetic idle / listening / speaking pattern when no audio is supplied (the SDK sets it).

runtimeInputs.label: Pointer
runtimeInputs.description: Pointer / touch scatter (pointerX, pointerY, pointerRadius, pointerStrength). The web view feeds it with `pointer: true`; on iOS and Android, pass the keys as overrides for now.

runtimeInputs.label: Interrupt
runtimeInputs.description: The one-shot barge-in flash: seconds since the interrupt (+ duration, strength, tint, hue).

runtimeInputs.label: Decay
runtimeInputs.description: A one-shot fade after an event: seconds since it (+ duration, curve, scale).

runtimeInputs.label: Aspect
runtimeInputs.description: Width / height of the view's box, for a box-layout pattern (the pattern's `layout: "box"`); the view sets it. 1 = square.

runtimeInputs.label: State age
runtimeInputs.description: Seconds since the view's lifecycle state last changed; the view sets it (a character blinks at the end of the user's turn).
